github.createPolicy: manual approval; do not auto-create issues from the plan

phases.name: Authority and ticket synchronization

phases.name: Bundle and embedded assets
phases.goal: Evidence-backed SEA spike, stable assets and dynamic dependencies.

phases.name: Universal install and upgrade

phases.name: Distribution proof and owner approval
phases.goal: No-Node installation and click-through evidence before publishing.
